g.text: Crafty — one recoverable container per agent session
acquire exclusive ownership; record next generation
inspect / stop any previous container for this session
If the old writer cannot be stopped, recovery stays pending.
Revoking API credentials does not prevent filesystem writes.
select this session's workspace + Codex-state volumes
create pinned image; mount at same absolute paths
register readers; initialize ACP + scoped MCP tools
save ACP session ID for application agentSessionId
session/resume or session/load(saved ACP session ID)
reconcile replay and task / turn state
Keep workspace, Codex state, ACP mapping, and task records.
Retiring a container is not deleting a session.
fence old generation; mark uncertain work interrupted
retain and remount the same session volumes
New container ID; same application session and saved ACP session.
Never blindly replay an uncertain prompt or side effect.
Conversational and CAD sessions recover independently.
TRD-7-12: same lifecycle for each agent role; no shared writable session mounts.
Browser reconnect replays application events and does not itself replace an agent container.
